name: Stochastic Jittering
aliases: Blue Noise Jittering for Banding Reduction
definition: A technique to reduce banding artifacts in volume rendering by adding stochastic jittering, controlled by a noise texture and a maximum noise factor.
summary: Stochastic jittering perturbs sample positions using a pre-computed noise texture to break periodicity, trading banding for dither patterns without per-sample random generation.
